layers.text: Camera: seen from the front and slightly above, like a vegetable garden on a strategy game map; drawn on a fully transparent background; nothing is cropped at the top or the bottom.

Class: crops for a square farm tile of a strategy game map: big plump simple plants growing in straight horizontal rows, each row on its own long narrow strip of tilled brown soil; a dark brown outline (never black), no box, no border and no frame. Everything that is not a plant or its strip of soil is empty and transparent.

layers.text: Subject: a small vegetable field: four thin low ridges of tilled soft tan-brown soil, one above the other, each a narrow line only a few pixels tall running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with wide empty transparent gaps between the ridges, the gaps wider than the ridges; on each ridge grows one row of five round bushy leafy lettuce plants side by side, fresh soft green with a lighter yellow-green highlight on the upper left and a darker green shadow on the lower right, each plant much taller than the thin ridge of soil it grows on. Crops and soil only.
